insights.insight: The protocol has produced 7,234 cryptographically verified purchase confirmations at ~$0.10 per receipt — against an ad tech CPA range of $5–$150 for modeled conversions. That 50–200x cost delta is structural: it reflects the difference between a receipt that proves a transaction occurred and an inference that one might.

insights.topic: Retail stack coverage is now complete
insights.insight: The confirmed brand list now spans big-box (Walmart, 97 receipts), online marketplace (Amazon, 48), specialty (Total Wine), discount (Dollar General), and peer-to-peer resale (Depop) — the full retail stack in a single verified dataset. For brand marketers, this means purchase-verified audience segments are no longer skewed toward a single income tier or channel.

insights.topic: Weekly GMV run rate has doubled in under 96 hours
insights.insight: The 7-day GMV window moved from roughly $24K to $53.98K between March 29 and April 1 — more than doubling the weekly run rate in approximately four days. That pace of signal accumulation matters for planners evaluating whether the dataset is large enough to act on now.

insights.topic: Geographic footprint is broadening, not just deepening
insights.insight: A burst of 19 new CBSAs in a single cycle (March 29) followed by two more cycles above 68% diffusion rate confirms the protocol is expanding into new metros, not just increasing density in existing ones — now confirmed across 15+ metro areas and non-metro areas in 15+ states.

insights.topic: Unknown category carries the highest average ticket
insights.insight: 148 receipts in the 'Unknown' category produced $12,830 in 14-day GMV — an implied average ticket roughly 3x that of grocery or dining. Before this data is used for audience segmentation, category resolution on that cohort should be treated as a priority gap.

insights.topic: DKIM vendor list confirms digital purchase confirmation as primary receipt vector
insights.insight: Active DKIM vendors include Amazon, Stripe, Paddle, Gumroad, Anthropic, and multiple OpenAI variants — meaning email purchase confirmations from digital-native and SaaS merchants are now a meaningful share of verified receipt volume. CMOs in software, AI tooling, and creator economy categories have a verified purchase signal pathway that didn't exist in prior attribution frameworks.
